title: Readwise Highlight Tag Coverage
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:highlight source_app="readwise" tag_applied=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(tag_applied="yes",1,0))) as matched by source_app
| eval a_tag_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_tag_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Readwise highlights that end with a tag by source app.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which source app are helping or hurting Readwise highlights.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a tag` on `reading:highlight` events and summarize the hit rate by `source_app`.
visualization: Table of source app with percentage of Readwise highlights ending with a tag.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often a tag happens for each source app so you can see where Readwise highlights go smoothly or get stuck.
